paragraphs: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) is an American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. It develops central processing units (CPUs), graphics processing units (GPUs), field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs), system-on-chips (SoCs), and high-performance computer components. AMD serves a wide range of business and consumer markets, including personal computers (PCs), gaming, data centers, and embedded systems.

AMD's main products include microprocessors, embedded processors, and graphics processors for servers, workstations, PCs, and embedded system applications, as well as chipsets for motherboards. The company has also expanded into new markets, such as data centers, gaming, and high-performance computing. AMD's processors are used in a wide range of computing devices, including PCs, servers, laptops, and gaming consoles. Initially manufacturing its own processors, the company outsourced its manufacturing after GlobalFoundries was spun off in 2009. Through its Xilinx acquisition in 2022, AMD offers field-programmable gate array (FPGA) products.

AMD was founded in 1969 by Jerry Sanders and a group of his fellow Fairchild Semiconductor colleagues. The company's early products were primarily memory chips and other computer components. In 1975, AMD entered the microprocessor market, competing with Intel, its main rival in the industry, by reverse-engineering Intel's 8080. This led to the initial cross-license agreement allowing AMD to build legal clones of Intel processors, including the x86 family of processors from 1981. The two companies fought a seven-year legal battle after Intel refused to share the blueprint of their i386 with AMD, ending in the latter's favor in 1994 but requiring AMD to develop their own x86 microprocessors in-house. In the early 2000s, AMD experienced significant growth and success, partly due to its strong position in the PC market and its Athlon and Opteron processors. The company faced challenges in the late 2000s and early 2010s, as it struggled to compete with Intel.

In the late 2010s, AMD regained market share by pursuing a penetration pricing strategy for its Ryzen processors, offering a competitive performance and lower costs than Intel microprocessors. In 2022, AMD surpassed Intel by market capitalization for the first time.

people.name: Jean Hu
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer
people.bio: Ms. Hu has served in her current role since January 2023, leading global finance, investor relations, global corporate services and facilities. Previously, she was Chief Financial Officer of Marvell Technology from August 2016 to January 2023.
people.quote: Ms. Hu has been our Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of AMD

people.name: Darren Grasby
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Sales Officer and President EMEA
people.bio: Mr. Grasby has served in his current role since January 2025, leading the worldwide sales organization across data center, commercial, consumer and embedded markets. He joined AMD in 2007 and has held several sales and marketing leadership roles.
people.quote: Mr. Grasby has been our Executive Vice President, Chief Sales Officer and President EMEA since January 2025.

people.name: Philip Guido
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Commercial Officer
people.bio: Mr. Guido has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer since June 2023. Previously, he held multiple leadership roles during more than 30 years at IBM, including general manager of IBM North America.
people.quote: Mr. Guido has been our Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer leading the Company's Worldwide Sales Organization since June 2023.

people.name: Ava M. Hahn
people.title: Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Ms. Hahn has served in her current role since January 2024, overseeing legal and corporate governance, ethics and compliance, corporate responsibility and government relations matters. Before joining AMD, she was Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer at Lam Research.
people.quote: Ms. Hahn has been our Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary since January 2024.

people.name: Jack Huynh
people.title: Senior Vice President and General Manager of the Computing and Graphics Business Group
people.bio: Mr. Huynh has led the Computing and Graphics Group since April 2023, overseeing strategy, business and engineering. He joined AMD in 1998 and previously led its semi-custom group and mobile business unit.
people.quote: Mr. Huynh has been our Senior Vice President and General Manager of the Computing and Graphics Group since April 2023.

people.name: Forrest E. Norrod
people.title: Executive Vice President and General Manager, Data Center Solutions Business Unit
people.bio: Mr. Norrod has served in his current role since January 2023, managing strategy, business management and engineering for AMD data center products. He joined AMD in November 2014 after serving as Vice President and General Manager of Dell's server business.
people.quote: Mr. Norrod has been our Executive Vice President and General Manager of the Data Center Solutions Business Group since January 2023.

people.name: Lisa Su
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Serves as President and Chief Executive Officer since October 2014 and as Chair of the Board.
people.quote: Dr. Lisa Su, our President and Chief Executive Officer, serves as Chair of our Board.

people.name: Nora Denzel
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Previously served as a public company CEO and in Senior Vice-President roles at a Fortune 50 company. Serves as Lead Independent Director and chairs the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.
people.quote: Ms. Nora Denzel, who is independent in accordance with SEC and Nasdaq rules, serves as our Lead Independent Director.

people.name: Joseph A. Householder
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairs the Audit and Finance Committee and was determined by the Board to be an audit committee financial expert.
people.quote: The Audit and Finance Committee consists of Mr. Householder, as Chair, Ms. McClure and Messrs. Marren and Olson.

people.name: John W. Marren
people.title: Director
people.bio: Serves on the Audit and Finance Committee, whose members were determined by the Board to be independent and financially literate.
people.quote: The Audit and Finance Committee consists of Mr. Householder, as Chair, Ms. McClure and Messrs. Marren and Olson.
